retained: mutation-01 (5 of 5 killed) ran on the working tree just before a8d4a1e3 was committed; its lease hash equals that commit's, but it recorded no failing test names. It is superseded by mutation-02, which ran at 2a92b201; the tested merge commit adds only C1 and F1 files and leaves the lease and its four test files unchanged.
da2-dev-01 (16 suites, 229 cases) ran before the denyAll test gained its 100 ms settle; it is not evidence for the tested commit.

In the real-Mongo suites the hold-off check is not what fails when removed (D1): those tests prove that each step still probes, and the in-window check against a prepared row. The unit suite proves the hold-off itself.
boundaries: Stacked on unmerged C1 and F1. Exact-head CI, merge, deployment and production acceptance remain pending.
The adapter stays uninjected; no activation, latency, load or savings claim. ADR 0071:47-48 stays true only while it is uninjected; the wiring slice owns the bounded-rate decision.
